svg.title: Physical map of Africa: rivers, lakes, deserts and highlands
svg.desc: Outline of Africa showing the Equator and the Tropics, the Rivers Nile, Congo, Niger, Zambezi and Orange, Lakes Victoria, Tanganyika, Malawi and Chad, the Sahara, Kalahari and Namib deserts, the Atlas Mountains, the Ethiopian Highlands, Mount Kilimanjaro and the Drakensberg, and the surrounding seas and oceans.
svg.text: S A H A R A
